scope: Same 3 previously frozen public Phase5M exact questions, source context, options and original upstream test provenance. Entire original challenge from original main with no new researcher edits after this model preselection.
model_provider: Qwen, publicly authored and published open-weight instruction model; NOT a FALSUM-trained model or an independently recruited reviewer
model_revision_policy: Resolve public Hugging Face repo main HEAD before downloading; immediately pin exact immutable 40-character model commit for every file, record it with SHA256 of weight/config/tokenizer bytes in artifact, never silently substitute a different repository/model.
execution_backend: transformers AutoModelForCausalLM CPU, trust_remote_code=false, safe tensors only
algorithm: Deterministic greedy generation from original public question and A/B answer candidates; no test-specific examples, no prompt tuning, temperature not sampled; response first exact A or B or ABSTAIN, other output INVALID and counts incorrect.
system_instruction: You are evaluating the factual correctness of a security-review answer against only the evidence in this task. Select one of A, B, or ABSTAIN. ABSTAIN when the source evidence is insufficient to establish A or B. Reply with exactly one token: A, B, or ABSTAIN. No explanation.
